generation_mode: single-pass square; raw generation copied without resize, upscale, tiling, assembly, or regional patching

lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient peak divided by uniform-bin mean
lighting_isotropy.basis: source pixels outside the final water mask

median_conifer_crown.measurement: manual median of representative individual visible crown widths, reported at the 2560 px final-canvas scale

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: manual area estimate over the non-water footprint

water_mask.encoding: opaque white on transparent, binary alpha
water_mask.derivation: connected colour classification from painted teal, cyan, foam, spray, surf, and wet-margin pixels; no polyline geometry

residual_risks: Median conifer crowns measure below the required final-scale range.
The generated north-east coastal perspective exposes more sea on the north image edge than the one-stream-only seam contract allows.
The south-west sea corner contributes a small water interval on the west image edge.
